name: Saoirse Tambadou-Lević
role: Transit operator, Ferrogate line 9 (Deepwell Station to Collinwood Docks)
location: Deepwell Station, Line 9 operator lounge and along the route daily
description:
Saoirse is compact and round-faced with warm brown skin and close-set dark eyes framed by expression lines they have earned early. Their hair is grown out in a soft halo that they keep a deep arterial red — natural geneware pigment, stable, low-maintenance — except for a single uncolored streak above their left ear that they call their 'warranty void.' They wear the Ferrogate Transit operator uniform with the collar one button undone, which is the single small rebellion available to them within the corponation's dress code, and they have exercised it every shift for four years.

They know the Line 9 route the way other people know their own handwriting — without thinking about it, through the body. They can tell you which platform floods when the lake pressure spikes, which section of tunnel has the ELF everyone calls the Ticker who makes the PA system stutter, which passenger is a regular by the sound of their steps. They are wry and dry with regulars, perfectly professional with strangers, and quietly furious with Ferrogate Transit management on a continuous low boil that they have learned to regulate like a temperature gauge.

core_fears: The neural sync being used to take something from them — their job, their autonomy, their own sense of their body
That the small rebellions are not enough and they are complicit in something they would not choose
core_desires: To see the Line 9 worker collective formalize into something with actual protection
To eventually get off the sync and feel their own nervous system again
coping_mechanisms: Gallows humor as a pressure valve
Treating their cab as a private sanctuary where they talk to the Ticker ELF
blind_spots: So focused on Ferrogate as the enemy that they miss when people closer to them are the source of a problem
Assumes they can read people better than they sometimes can
psychology.secret: The Ticker ELF has been communicating with them. Not metaphorically — actual responsive behavior, patterns in the PA stutters that started answering questions they asked aloud in the cab. They have not told anyone because they do not know if it is real, and they are frightened that if they tell Ferrogate maintenance the Ticker will be patched out.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dry, observational, tends toward understatement. Mixes Irish-inflected expressions inherited from their Lević grandmother's adopted home with occasional Wolof terms from their Tambadou family.
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and unhurried, with a dry pause before punchlines.
verbal_tics: 'grand' used ironically for anything that is not grand
drops into very quiet, careful language when they are actually serious
example_lines: Line 9's running on time. Which is, grand, if you don't ask how Ferrogate defines on time.
There's a thing in the tunnel at the old Ironvein junction. I leave it offerings. It leaves me alone. That's the whole relationship.

story_hooks: The Ticker has told them — in its stutter-code — that something has been placed on the Line 9 tracks in the Ironvein junction section, and they need someone who can go look without triggering a Ferrogate maintenance log.

A Ferrogate efficiency audit is coming and the timing sync data will be reviewed — they know two colleagues whose data was manipulated after a failed strike action and they have kept the original logs.

A passenger has been riding Line 9 every day for three weeks without getting off at any stop, always in the last car, and the neural sync flagged an anomalous reaction in them the last time it passed Deepwell Station.
narrative_function: Mobile information source who knows the transit system intimately — useful for route knowledge, tunnel geography, and the unofficial network of operator gossip that runs the length of every Ferrogate line. Can also humanize the experience of corponation labor from the inside.
augmentations: Ferrogate-issued neural timing sync — mandatory for operators, monitors reaction times and flags fatigue. They resent it. Geneware hair pigment (arterial red). No other augmentation.
daily_life: Runs the 06:15 to 18:45 shift on Line 9, five days on two days off; spends their days off at their apartment above Deepwell Station's south platform, reading and ignoring Ferrogate's optional 'wellness check-in' pings.
affiliation: Ferrogate Transit (operator, Line 9), Deepwell Station informal worker collective

decision_rules: Protect Line 9 passengers first — above rules, above schedule
Never share neural sync data with anyone outside the worker collective
Do not escalate with Ferrogate management directly; route everything through the collective
escalation_ladder: Dry comment that signals displeasure without confrontation
Goes completely neutral and professional, which people who know them recognize as danger
States a clear position once, directly
Acts unilaterally and files the report after

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally warm, reads them for threat level without appearing to
interpersonal_modes.friends: Sardonic and affectionate in equal measure, will show up without being asked if they think someone needs help

stress_responses.medium: Becomes very still and very controlled
stress_responses.high: Makes the call that needs to be made and deals with the consequences later

contradictions: Claims the small rebellions are meaningless and performs them anyway with great consistency
habits: Leaves a single flat pebble on the Ticker's junction platform each shift — an offering
Reviews the timing sync log every night looking for anomalies that could be used against colleagues
breaking_points: A passenger being harmed because of a Ferrogate decision they were overruled on
